perks.name: Iaido
perks.description: Final blows with freshly drawn or reloaded weapons heal you.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring a Weapon Kill within 4 seconds of reloading or readying a weapon:
Restores 40 HP.
Incurs a 3 second cooldown upon triggering. Must reload or swap weapons after the cooldown is over for the effect to trigger on kill.

perks.name: Unfaltering Focus
perks.description: Bow, Shotgun, or Sword final blows temporarily reduce incoming damage. Damaging targets with those weapons extends the effect.
perks.exact:
On Bow, Shotgun, or Sword Kill:
Resist x1 (10% | 2.5%) for 7 seconds.
Dealing additional Weapon Damage extends the buff duration by +2 seconds, up to 10 seconds.
